description: RESEARCH-ONLY. The one table of providers and layers rw-scenario may use. Validation goes by layer kind (geocoder, vector, elevation), never by provider id, so a provider is swapped here and nowhere else. terms_checked says when and where the terms were read; a row whose terms were not re-read says so.

providers.attribution: Place candidates: Nominatim, data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
providers.allowed_purpose: occasional single-place search under the usage policy https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/ : at most 1 request a second, identifying User-Agent, results cached, no bulk, no autocomplete, no systematic queries
providers.retention: results cached by the client, as the usage policy requires
providers.redistribution: allowed under ODbL with attribution and share-alike

providers.attribution: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
providers.allowed_purpose: one bounded serial query per snapshot, far under the fair-use guide (< 10 000 queries and < 1 GB a day; regular use a hundredth of that); back off 30 s after HTTP 429
providers.retention: raw answer cached locally (ignored by git); the snapshot keeps normalised features only
providers.redistribution: allowed under ODbL with attribution and share-alike; the fixture is an ODbL extract

providers.allowed_purpose: anonymous HTTPS range reads of the Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF tiles covering the extent, no account (AWS Open Data); only the TIFF directories and the internal tiles the sample grid needs are read, never a whole file that is not needed; a Digital Surface Model (buildings and canopy included)
providers.retention: the bytes read are cached locally (ignored by git); the snapshot keeps the sampled grid and the SHA-256 of every range read
providers.redistribution: allowed with the Art. 6 notices; Subsequent Users are bound by the same obligations (Art. 6(e))
